about.en: Zoom bStock (ZMB) is a tokenized share of Zoom Communications, Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xf4ddb292fe88e476eddd9869d386705e6bfab7a2, backed 1:1 by ZM shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
